items.source: After a DispatcherServlet has received a request and has done its work to resolve locales, and suchlike, it then tries to resolve a Controller, using a HandlerMapping. When a Controller has been found to handle the request, the handleRequest method of the located Controller will be invoked; the located Controller is then responsible for handling the actual request and — if applicable — returning an appropriate ModelAndView. So actually, this method is the main entry point for the DispatcherServlet which delegates requests to controllers.
items.translation: 在 `DispatcherServlet` 接收到请求并完成了解析区域设置（locales）等工作后，它会尝试使用一个 HandlerMapping 来解析控制器。一旦找到能够处理该请求的控制器，所定位控制器的 handleRequest 方法将被调用；该控制器随后负责实际处理请求，并在适用时返回一个合适的 ModelAndView。因此，实际上，此方法是 DispatcherServlet 的主要入口点，它将请求委托给控制器处理。

items.source: So basically any direct implementation of the Controller interface just handles HttpServletRequests and should return a ModelAndView, to be further interpreted by the DispatcherServlet. Any additional functionality such as optional validation, form handling, etc. should be obtained through extending AbstractController or one of its subclasses.
items.translation: 因此，任何直接实现Controller接口的类仅处理HttpServletRequest并应返回一个ModelAndView，以便由DispatcherServlet进一步解释。任何额外功能（如可选验证、表单处理等）都应通过扩展AbstractController或其子类之一来获取。

items.source: Controllers can use the checkNotModified methods on WebRequest for HTTP caching support.
items.translation: 控制器可以使用 checkNotModified 方法在 WebRequest 上实现 HTTP 缓存支持。

items.source: Controllers can easily be tested by passing in mock objects for the HttpServletRequest and HttpServletResponse objects as parameters to the handleRequest method. As a convenience, Spring ships with a set of Servlet API mocks that are suitable for testing any kind of web components, but are particularly suitable for testing Spring web controllers. In contrast to a Struts Action, there is no need to mock the ActionServlet or any other infrastructure; mocking HttpServletRequest and HttpServletResponse is sufficient.
items.translation: 可以通过将 `HttpServletRequest` 和 `ServletResponse` 对象的模拟对象作为参数传递给 handleRequest 方法，轻松测试控制器。作为一种便利措施，Spring 提供了一套适用于测试任何类型 Web 组件的 Servlet API 模拟对象，但特别适合测试 Spring Web 控制器。与 Struts Action 不同，无需模拟 ActionServlet 或任何其他基础设施；只需模拟 `HttpServletRequest` 和 `HttpServletResponse` 即可。

items.source: Any implementation of the Controller interface should be a reusable, thread-safe class, capable of handling multiple HTTP requests throughout the lifecycle of an application. To be able to configure a Controller easily, Controller implementations are encouraged to be (and usually are) JavaBeans.
items.translation: 任何实现 `Controller` 接口的类都应该是可重用且线程安全的，能够在整个应用程序生命周期中处理多个 HTTP 请求。为了能够轻松配置 `Controller`，鼓励（并且通常也是）将 `Controller` 的实现设计为 JavaBeans。

items.source:
The Controller interface is explicitly designed to operate on HttpServletRequest
and HttpServletResponse objects, just like an HttpServlet. It does not aim to
decouple itself from the Servlet API, in contrast to, for example, WebWork, JSF or Tapestry.
Instead, the full power of the Servlet API is available, allowing Controllers to be
general-purpose: a Controller is able to not only handle web user interface
requests but also to process remoting protocols or to generate reports on demand.
items.translation: Controller 接口被明确设计为像 HttpServlet 一样操作 HttpServletRequest 和 HttpServletResponse 对象。与 WebWork、JSF 或 Tapestry 等框架不同，它并不旨在与 Servlet API 解耦。相反，Servlet API 的全部功能均可使用，这使得 Controller 能够通用化：Controller 不仅能够处理 Web 用户界面请求，还可以处理远程协议或按需生成报告。

items.source:
If Controllers need to be aware of specific environment references, they can
choose to implement specific awareness interfaces, just like any other bean in a
Spring (web) application context can do, for example:
items.translation: 如果 Controller 需要感知特定的环境引用，它们可以选择实现特定的感知接口，就像 Spring（Web）应用程序上下文中的任何其他 Bean 一样，例如：

items.source:
Such environment references can easily be passed in testing environments,
through the corresponding setters defined in the respective awareness interfaces.
In general, it is recommended to keep the dependencies as minimal as possible:
for example, if all you need is resource loading, implement ResourceLoaderAware only.
Alternatively, derive from the WebApplicationObjectSupport base class, which gives
you all those references through convenient accessors but requires an
ApplicationContext reference on initialization.
items.translation: 此类环境引用可以轻松地在测试环境中通过相应感知接口中定义的对应 setter 方法传入。通常建议尽可能保持依赖最小化：例如，如果您仅需资源加载功能，则只需实现 `ResourceLoaderAware` 接口。或者，您可以继承自 `WebApplicationObjectSupport` 基类，该类通过便捷的访问器提供所有这些引用，但需要在初始化时提供一个 `ApplicationContext` 引用。

items.source: Process the request and return a ModelAndView object which the DispatcherServlet will render. A null return value is not an error: it indicates that this object completed request processing itself and that there is therefore no ModelAndView to render.
items.translation: 返回一个由 `DispatcherServlet` 渲染的 `ModelAndView` 对象。null 返回值并非错误：它表示该对象自身已完成请求处理，因此无需渲染任何 `ModelAndView`。

items.translation: Exception - 在发生错误时

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
